h: BBNaija's Saskay says she missed flight because of road closure for Tinubu
p: Former BBNaija star Saskay has called out President Tinubu after saying she missed her flight when security operatives blocked an airport road for the President's movement. She said many travellers were stuck for hours.
body: Former Big Brother Naija housemate Saskay has called out President Bola Tinubu after she said she missed her flight because of a road closure near the airport.

In a post on X, the reality TV star said security operatives blocked a section of the airport road because the President was attending a conference nearby. She said the restriction left many motorists stuck in traffic for hours, causing her and several other travellers to miss their flights.
Visibly frustrated, Saskay questioned why ordinary citizens going about their business should be inconvenienced in this way.
There was no official response to her complaint in the reports.
more: She says the road was blocked for the President.
She posted her complaint on X.
